caption: The drawing features a single, centrally positioned metallic bowl, rendered in shades of grey pencil. The bowl is depicted with reflective surfaces, showcasing light and shadow that indicate its curved form and smooth material. It is set within a square boundary drawn lightly on an off-white background. The bowl itself has a round opening, slightly wider than its base, and the reflection details inside the bowl suggest a shiny or polished texture. There are no additional objects or embellishments within the drawn square. At the bottom left corner of the page, outside the square boundary, the name "Vincent Carano" is written in capital letters. The overall composition is minimal, with the bowl occupying the center of the outlined square.
title: Silver Wine Tumbler
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
